quality_policy.rule: No technique is included to meet a numeric quota.
quality_policy.inclusion: Each record must have a recognized technical source and/or elite competition/direct-instruction validation, a current rules/safety review, and a distinct technical purpose.
quality_policy.elite_variants: C records are verified and effective but style-dependent; they are not universal defaults.
quality_policy.reference_only: D records, if present, are reference-only and excluded from normal progression.

level_definitions.beginner: Foundational actions with low prerequisite burden; balance, safety and repeatable mechanics come first.
level_definitions.intermediate: Established fundamentals plus timing, chaining, positional awareness or reaction-based execution.
level_definitions.advanced: Higher coordination, reaction dependence, positional risk, rules complexity, specialist execution or elite-system variation.

sources.name: IFMA — Education Modules
sources.use: Muaythai Basics, Mae Mai, Jhap Kau clinch and Pongkan defence.

sources.name: Muay Thai Library — Preserve the Legacy
sources.use: Long-form first-person instruction from elite Thai champions; used to validate variants and application.

sources.name: IFMA — Muaythai Rules & Regulations v3.0 (2026)
sources.use: Current 2026 IFMA competition standards, permitted techniques and prohibited actions.

sources.name: Buakaw Banchamek — Authentic Muay Thai Striking
sources.use: Direct elite instruction on long guard, counters, knees, clinch, sweeps and ring control.

sources.name: Master Kru Manop — Grass Roots Muay Thai Fundamentals
sources.use: Traditional stance, punches, elbows, knees, kicks, teeps, clinch positions, sweeps and escapes.

sources.name: Jean-Charles Skarbowsky — Muay Thai Masterclass: Intermediate
sources.use: Feints, kick timing, kick catches, defensive counters, sweeps and knee defence.

sources.name: Jompop Kiatphontip — Muay Thai Elbows & Sweeps
sources.use: Elbow setups, kick/teep catches, counters and clinch sweeping.
